$comment: Shared mascot spec for the website (opiskeluakatemia/) and the mobile app (opiskeluakatemia-mobile/). Both apps import or copy this file; change copy and rules here, not in components. Character working name: Abi. See research/mascot-polku-plan.md.
name: Abi

rules.decorative: When the moment's text already says the same thing, render the mascot with empty alt / accessibilityElementsHidden. Never put information only in the mascot.
rules.reducedMotion: Stills only. No entry animation beyond an opacity fade.
rules.rotateLines: pickLine(moment, dateYmd, userId, vars = {}) -> string | null. Eligible lines = lines whose {placeholders} all exist in vars (null if none). Index = FNV-1a 32-bit over UTF-16 code units of `${moment}|${dateYmd}|${userId}` (h = 0x811c9dc5; per unit: h ^= c; h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0) % eligible.length. Fill with line.replace(/\{(\w+)\}(\.?)/g, (_, k, dot) => /[?!.]$/.test(String(vars[k])) ? String(vars[k]) : String(vars[k]) + dot) so a value ending in ? ! . swallows a following '.'. Vars: {lesson} = lesson title, or 'Välietappi: <unit title>' for a checkpoint; {level} = new level title; {streak} = streak.current. dateYmd = summary.today (Helsinki, from server); userId = Supabase user id or 'anon'.
rules.momentForResult: Not passed -> lessonFailed. Else if under maxBigCelebrationsPerDay: unitCompleted (rewards.unitCompleted) then levelUp (rewards.leveledUp). Else dailyGoalReached (rewards.dailyGoalReached), lessonPerfect (score === 100), lessonPassed. Caller increments the daily big-celebration count only for unitCompleted / levelUp.
rules.streakAtRisk: summary.streak.current > 0 && !summary.streak.practicedToday && Helsinki hour of now >= 18 (Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', {timeZone:'Europe/Helsinki', hour:'2-digit', hourCycle:'h23'})).

onboarding.when: Path summary has xp.total === 0 and the intro has not been dismissed (local flag mascot.introDismissed).
onboarding.title: Moi, mä oon Abi.
lines: Käydään englannin yo-koe läpi pala kerrallaan. Jokainen oppitunti vie noin 5 minuuttia.
Läpäiset oppitunnin 80 %:lla. Tarkistuspiste avaa seuraavan osion. Väärät vastaukset tulevat myöhemmin kertaukseen.

pathHere.when: Small figure beside the next lesson node on the path map (the node returned by nextLessonId). Only there, never on every node.

nextUpDaily.when: Next-up card, first open of the day (local flag mascot.greetedOn = YYYY-MM-DD). Otherwise idle.
lines: Yksi oppitunti tänään riittää pitämään putken käynnissä.

lessonPassed.when: Result screen, passed, no bigger reward.

lessonFailed.when: Result screen, not passed. Supportive, never disappointed.
lines: Vielä ei mennyt läpi, mutta virheistä näkee, mitä kerrata.
Katso selitykset ja kokeile uudestaan. Paras tulos jää voimaan.

unitCompleted.when: rewards.unitCompleted. Wins over levelUp when both happen. Counts toward maxBigCelebrationsPerDay; beyond the cap fall through to dailyGoalReached / lessonPerfect / lessonPassed.
lines: Koko osio tehty. Seuraava on auki.

levelUp.when: rewards.leveledUp (and not unitCompleted). Counts toward maxBigCelebrationsPerDay; beyond the cap fall through like unitCompleted.

dailyGoalReached.when: rewards.dailyGoalReached (and no bigMilestone in the same result).

streakAtRisk.when: streak.current > 0 && !streak.practicedToday && Helsinki local time >= 18:00. Describe the state, never blame.
lines: Putki on vielä pelastettavissa: yksi oppitunti riittää.
{streak} päivän putki jatkuu, kun teet tänään yhden oppitunnin.

reviewEmpty.when: Kertaus has nothing to review. Frame as an achievement.
lines: Ei kerrattavaa. Kaikki virheet on korjattu.

allDone.when: All available units completed (nextLessonId === null and units remain coming_soon).
lines: Kaikki valmiit osiot on tehty. Uusia osioita tulee pian. Sillä välin kertaa korteilla.

loading.when: Optional, only for waits over ~1 s (e.g. AI essay feedback). Keep the existing spinner/skeleton as well.
